{{Short description|none}}
Outside of the [[2026 Nations Championship]], the [[2026 World Rugby Nations Cup]], the [[2026 Six Nations Championship]] and other regional tournaments, a series of international matches will be played throughout the year. [[New Zealand national rugby union team|New Zealand]] will play an eight-match tour of [[South Africa]], playing against the [[United Rugby Championship]] (URC) sides and four tests against the [[South Africa national rugby union team|South Africa national team]], with the fourth test being played at [[M&T Bank Stadium]] in [[Baltimore]].<ref name="Springboks v All Blacks"/> Similarly, [[Australia national rugby union team|Australia]] and [[Japan national rugby union team|Japan]] will embark on a home-and-away tour of each other for the first time in their history; the former following that series with a [[2026 Australia rugby union tour of Argentina|tour of Argentina]].

'''Notes:'''
* [[Takumi Inaba]], [[Inoke Burua]] (both Japan), [[Bryce Worden]], and [[Jamie Armstrong (rugby union)|Jamie Armstrong]] (both Canada) all made their international [[Test match (rugby union)|test]] debut.
* This was Japan's centenary test, celebrating 100 years since the formation of the [[Japan Rugby Football Union]] (JRFU).<ref name=jpn-can>{{cite news |last=Newcombe |first=Jon |date=4 September 2026 |title=Dearns out, Japan change captain for Centenary Test vs Canada |url=https://www.rugbypass.com/news/japan-change-captain-for-centenary-test-vs-canada/ |work=[[RugbyPass]] |access-date=8 September 2026 }}</ref>
* Japan's 57 points was the most they had scored against Canada, equaling their previous record achieved in [[2025 World Rugby Pacific Nations Cup#Pool B|2025]].<ref name=jpn-can/><ref name=jpn-can-stats>{{cite web |date= |title=Head to Head: Canada–Japan {{!}} Rugby Database |url=https://www.rugbydatabase.com.au/team/head-team-games.php?teamId=40&oppositionId=46 |website=rugbydatabase.com.au |publisher=Rugby Database |access-date=6 September 2026 }}</ref> It was also the largest victory (by margin) Japan had recorded against Canada.<ref name=jpn-can/><ref name=jpn-can-stats/>

'''Notes:'''
* [[Facundo Cardozo (rugby union)|Facundo Cardozo]] and [[Mateo Soler]] (both Argentina) made their international [[Test match (rugby union)|test]] debuts.
* [[Tom Wright (rugby, born 1997)|Tom Wright]] (Australia) earned his 50th test cap.<ref>{{cite web |date=4 September 2026 |title=Wright to bring up 50, Donaldson to start against Los Pumas in Mendoza |url=https://wallabies.rugby/news/wallabies-team-confirmed-to-play-argentina-in-mendoza-202693 |website=wallabies.rugby |publisher=[[Rugby Australia]] |access-date=4 September 2026 }}</ref>
* With this draw, Australia won the series 1–0, securing their [[History of rugby union matches between Argentina and Australia#List of series|first series]] victory in Argentina.<ref>{{cite news |last=Pentony |first=Luke |date=6 September 2026 |title=Wallabies vs Pumas second Test in Mendoza — live blog, stats and scores |url=https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-09-06/australia-wallabies-pumas-argentina-rugby-test-live-blog/107120012?utm_campaign=abc_news_web&utm_content=link&utm_medium=content_shared&utm_source=abc_news_web#live-blog-post-337952 |work=[[ABC News (Australia)|ABC News]] |access-date=6 September 2026 }}</ref>
* Australia reclaimed the [[Puma Trophy]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Drennan |first1=Jonathan |last2=Payten |first2=Iain |date=6 September 2026 |title=Injury worry for star playmaker after Wallabies botch chance against 13-man Pumas |url=https://www.smh.com.au/sport/rugby-union/wallabies-2026-live-updates-australia-takes-on-argentina-in-mendoza-20260905-p60uqq.html?post=p5b2kw&gb=1 |work=The Sydney Morning Herald |publisher=Nine Entertainment |access-date=6 September 2026 }}</ref>
